messages:
Maya L: FYI: rolling schema change tonight 01:30 UTC to add accounts.is_active_v2. Plan: quiesce per-region, apply ADD COLUMN, then run staggered backfill. I'll coordinate.

Theo R: Which services to pin?

Maya L: Pin account-api + login-service to v2.8.3 for a 40m window. Workers will not enable writes until backfill reaches 80% per region.

Sam B: I'll own lock-watch and rollback triggers. Criteria: >8 RowExclusive locks for 3m OR p99 write latency >1.5s sustained 10m = abort.

deploybot: Deploybot queued canary at 3112345900 (cb-1021). Attach migration artifact and sha.

Maya L: Uploaded SQL at s3://releases/3112345678/add_is_active_v2.sql migration_sha=ac9f12. Rollback runbook uploaded too.

Sam B: Lock alert added: queries count RowExclusive >8 for 180s -> ping #eng-oncall and @Theo R.

Theo R: If lock alert fires, plan is: 1) pause backfill 2) revert feature flag writes 3) (only if needed) drop column. I can redeploy services to previous tag quickly.

deploybot: Canary cb-1021 started 3112345905.

Maya L: us-east1 quiesce OK. eu-west1 delayed 40s then ok. ap-northeast1 ok. Proceeding with backfill in sequence.

Sam B: us-east1 RowExclusive briefly hit 10 for 2.5m -> alert posted. Killed offending batch (pid 44321). Locks fell back.

Theo R: Good. Metrics recovered, p95 steady. Approving promote in +12m if no more alerts.

deploybot: Canary healthy at 3112345980. Holding auto-promote per request.

Maya L: Promoted at 3112346030. Feature flag toggled for writes. Post-checks show backfills completed across regions, no deadlocks, latencies within tolerance.

Sam B: Closing watch; keeping alerting on for 30m. Added release note: "accounts.is_active_v2 added; staged cross-region backfill; services pinned during window."

deploybot: Deploy summary: canary cb-1021 -> promoted. migration_sha=ac9f12.
